meaning_en: To seem to be something.
example_en: She appears happy today.
examples_extra: She appeared calm, but I knew she was nervous inside.
The baby appeared to be sleeping peacefully in his cot.
note_fa: الگو: appear + صفت یا appear to be.

meaning_en: Having a pleasant, strong smell.
example_en: The aromatic spices filled the kitchen with scent.
examples_extra: The kitchen smelled aromatic with fresh herbs and spices.
She lit an aromatic candle that filled the room with a sweet smell.
note_fa: در کتاب برای بوی خوش (herbs) در کنار fragrant.

meaning_en: In a way that suggests something is true.
example_en: He looked as if he hadn't slept.
examples_extra: She talked as if she knew everything about the topic.
He looked at me as though I were a stranger.
note_fa: بعد از آن معمولاً فعل گذشته می‌آید: as if he were.

meaning_en: Having a strong, sharp taste, not sweet.
example_en: This coffee is very bitter.
examples_extra: The coffee was too bitter, so I added some sugar.
Dark chocolate can taste bitter, but many people love it.
note_fa: کتاب: bitter برای قهوه تلخ؛ sour برای لیمو.

meaning_en: Extremely loud, making it hard to hear.
example_en: The thunder was deafening.
examples_extra: The music was so loud it was deafening.
A deafening cheer rose from the crowd.

meaning_en: The feeling of having experienced something before.
example_en: I had a strange sense of déjà vu.
examples_extra: Walking into that café, I suddenly felt a strange déjà vu.
She had a strong feeling of déjà vu in the old house.
note_fa: حس آشنا بودن یک لحظهٔ جدید؛ فقط اسم است و جمع ندارد.

meaning_en: To experience a physical sensation.
example_en: I feel cold today.
examples_extra: I feel tired after work.
Do you feel better now?

meaning_en: To experience an emotion or physical sensation.
example_en: I feel happy when I listen to music.
examples_extra: He could feel a sharp pain in his leg.
We feel happy to see you.

meaning_en: having a very bad smell.
example_en: The garbage had a foul-smelling odor.
examples_extra: A foul-smelling liquid leaked from the bin.
The foul-smelling fish had gone bad.

meaning_en: having a pleasant, sweet smell.
example_en: The flowers in the garden are very fragrant.
examples_extra: Fragrant flowers filled the garden.
The fragrant tea comes from Sri Lanka.

meaning_en: to look at something for a long time.
example_en: She gazed at the beautiful sunset.
examples_extra: She gazed out of the window for an hour.
He gazed at the stars in silence.
note_fa: نگاه طولانی و خیره؛ با at می‌آید: gaze at.

meaning_en: To look quickly at something.
example_en: He glanced at his watch.
examples_extra: He glanced at his watch and hurried away.
She glanced out of the window.
note_fa: یعنی نگاه سریع؛ با stare (خیره شدن) فرق دارد.

meaning_en: A very quick, incomplete look at something.
example_en: I caught a glimpse of the celebrity.
examples_extra: I caught a glimpse of the sea from the train.
She had only a brief glimpse of the actor.
note_fa: یعنی نگاه بسیار کوتاه و ناقص.

meaning_en: to take hold of something quickly and suddenly.
example_en: He grabbed his bag and left.
examples_extra: He grabbed my hand suddenly.
She grabbed her bag and left.

meaning_en: to understand something completely.
example_en: I couldn't quite grasp the concept.
examples_extra: She quickly grasped the main idea.
He could not grasp what she meant.

meaning_en: The part of an object you hold.
example_en: The cup handle was broken.
examples_extra: The door handle came off in my hand yesterday.
Hold the pan by its handle; it is very hot.

meaning_en: Perceive sound with your ears.
example_en: Can you hear the music playing?
examples_extra: I can hear loud music from next door.
Have you heard the latest news about them?
note_fa: شنیدن؛ با can: I can hear.

meaning_en: The ability to perceive sounds.
example_en: His hearing is not as good as it used to be.
examples_extra: The poor old man is losing his hearing.
She has remarkably excellent hearing for quiet music.

meaning_en: Feeling warm or having a high temperature.
example_en: I feel hot today.
examples_extra: The soup is too hot to eat.
It was a very hot day.

meaning_en: The ability to know something without thinking about it.
example_en: I had an intuition that something was wrong.
examples_extra: She followed her intuition and left early.
My intuition told me something was wrong.

meaning_en: Similar to; in the same way as.
example_en: She sings like a bird.
examples_extra: She looks exactly like her mother when she smiles.
This homemade cake tastes just like real chocolate.

meaning_en: To hear and pay attention.
example_en: Please listen carefully to the instructions.
examples_extra: You never listen when I speak to you.
Please listen carefully because this is very important.

meaning_en: direct your eyes to see something.
example_en: Look at the beautiful sunset!
examples_extra: Look at the beautiful sunset.
She looked out of the window.
note_fa: look at یعنی «نگاه کردن به»؛ look (بدون at) ناقص است.

meaning_en: (n) an act of seeing; (v) direct your eyes.
example_en: He gave a quick look at the clock.
examples_extra: Take a look at this report.
She took one look and left.
note_fa: اسم: take/have a look یعنی «نگاهی انداختن».

meaning_en: making a lot of noise.
example_en: The music was too loud.
examples_extra: The music is too loud.
They heard a loud noise outside.

meaning_en: Not cold, not hot; pleasant.
example_en: The weather is mild today.
examples_extra: We had a mild autumn with little rain.
She has a mild fever.
note_fa: برای هوا: معتدل؛ برای بیماری: خفیف.

meaning_en: Smelling old, damp, or not fresh.
example_en: The old books had a musty smell.
examples_extra: The ancient books smelled old, damp and musty.
A strong, musty smell came from the cellar.
note_fa: بوی نم و کهنگی؛ musty smell.

meaning_en: Making no sound at all.
example_en: The cat moved in a noiseless way.
examples_extra: The new car engine is almost noiseless.
She moved with noiseless steps across the room.

meaning_en: Making a lot of loud sounds.
example_en: The children are very noisy today.
examples_extra: Our neighbours are very noisy at night.
The classroom was too noisy to study in.

meaning_en: A sign or information displayed for people.
example_en: I saw a notice about the concert.
examples_extra: There is a notice on the door about the meeting.
Please read the notice before entering.

meaning_en: To watch carefully, especially to learn something.
example_en: Scientists observe animals in nature.
examples_extra: We observed the birds from behind the trees.
Scientists observed changes in the climate.

meaning_en: To touch gently with an open hand.
example_en: She patted the dog on its head.
examples_extra: He patted the dog gently.
She patted her son on the head.

meaning_en: To look closely or with difficulty.
example_en: She had to peer through the fog.
examples_extra: He peered through the dark window.
She peered at the small print.

meaning_en: Having a pleasant smell added.
example_en: She bought perfumed soap for the bathroom.
examples_extra: She wore a perfumed lotion.
The garden was full of perfumed flowers.

meaning_en: To push something quickly with your finger or a stick.
example_en: Don't poke the animal with that stick.
examples_extra: He poked me in the back.
She poked the fire with a stick.

meaning_en: A strong feeling that something bad will happen.
example_en: She had a premonition about the accident.
examples_extra: She had a premonition of danger.
His strange premonition came true.

meaning_en: Newspapers and magazines, or the people who write for them.
example_en: The press reported on the event.
examples_extra: The press asked many questions.
She works for the press.

meaning_en: Having a very strong, sharp smell or taste.
example_en: The cheese had a very pungent smell.
examples_extra: The cheese has a pungent smell.
Pungent spices filled the kitchen.

meaning_en: Decaying and smelling very bad.
example_en: The putrid smell came from the rotten food.
examples_extra: The putrid smell filled the room.
The food had gone putrid.
note_fa: یعنی گندیده و بدبو؛ خیلی قوی‌تر از bad است.

meaning_en: making little or no noise
example_en: The library is a very quiet place.
examples_extra: Please be quiet; the baby is sleeping.
It's very quiet here tonight.

meaning_en: Tasting of salt.
example_en: The chips were too salty for me.
examples_extra: The soup is too salty.
Sea water always tastes salty.
note_fa: کتاب: salty = a lot of salt؛ شور.

meaning_en: Having a pleasant smell.
example_en: I bought a scented candle for my room.
examples_extra: She lit a scented candle.
The garden was full of scented roses.
note_fa: معطر؛ scented candle یعنی شمع معطر.

meaning_en: To watch a film or play.
example_en: Did you see the new movie?
examples_extra: We saw a great film last night.
Did you see the match yesterday?
note_fa: see/saw/seen؛ see a film یعنی فیلم دیدن.

meaning_en: To perceive with your eyes.
example_en: I can see the mountains from here.
examples_extra: I can see the mountains from here.
Can you see that bird?
note_fa: see یعنی دیدن غیرارادی؛ watch یعنی تماشای ارادی.

meaning_en: To appear to be something.
example_en: He seems happy today.
examples_extra: You seem a bit tired today.
It seems like a good idea.
note_fa: seem + صفت: seem happy؛ با to هم می‌آید: seem to be.

meaning_en: The ability to see.
example_en: His sight is getting worse with age.
examples_extra: He tragically lost his sight in the accident.
The beautiful sight amazed us all again today.

meaning_en: Not making any sound; quiet.
example_en: The room was completely silent.
examples_extra: The old house was completely silent tonight.
She remained completely silent throughout the long trial.

meaning_en: To notice an odor with your nose.
example_en: I can smell something burning.
examples_extra: I can smell fresh bread.
These fresh flowers smell really lovely.

meaning_en: (n) An odor; (v) to perceive an odor.
example_en: The smell of flowers is lovely.
examples_extra: What a strange smell in here!
I smell smoke in the kitchen.

meaning_en: To quickly take something rudely or illegally.
example_en: The thief snatched her bag.
examples_extra: The thief snatched her bag.
He snatched the ball from me.

meaning_en: Something you hear.
example_en: I heard a strange sound outside.
examples_extra: I heard a strange sound coming from upstairs.
The sound of the waves relaxed us.

meaning_en: Having a sharp, acidic taste like lemon.
example_en: Lemons have a very sour taste.
examples_extra: These lemons taste very sour, not sweet.
The milk has gone sour; don't drink it.

meaning_en: Food with a strong, hot taste.
example_en: I like spicy food, like chili.
examples_extra: This curry is too spicy for me.
She really likes hot and spicy Mexican food.

meaning_en: Look at someone or something for a long time.
example_en: It's rude to stare at people.
examples_extra: It is considered rude to stare at people.
The little child stared at the magician.

meaning_en: Having a very bad and unpleasant smell.
example_en: The garbage bin was stinking badly.
examples_extra: The old fish in the bin was stinking.
Please take those stinking shoes outside now!

meaning_en: A sudden serious illness affecting the brain.
example_en: He had a stroke and lost his speech.
examples_extra: Her father had a stroke last year.
She recovered remarkably well after the stroke.

meaning_en: Having a taste like sugar or honey.
example_en: This cake is very sweet and delicious.
examples_extra: The tea is too sweet.
She likes sweet desserts after dinner.

meaning_en: Having a pleasant, often sugary, smell.
example_en: The flowers in the garden were sweet-smelling.
examples_extra: The roses are sweet-smelling and red.
She wore a sweet-smelling perfume.

meaning_en: A device that controls water flow.
example_en: Turn off the tap to save water.
examples_extra: Please turn on the tap.
The kitchen tap is dripping.

meaning_en: What someone likes or prefers.
example_en: She has good taste in music.
examples_extra: She has very good taste.
Our tastes in music differ.

meaning_en: Sense the flavor of food or drink.
example_en: Can you taste the salt in this soup?
examples_extra: Please taste this hot soup.
Good chefs taste the food.

meaning_en: Showing good judgment about style and beauty.
example_en: The room was decorated in a very tasteful way.
examples_extra: She has very tasteful furniture.
The room looks very tasteful.

meaning_en: Having no flavor or a very bad flavor.
example_en: This soup is tasteless; it needs salt.
examples_extra: This soup is quite tasteless.
He wore a tasteless tie.

meaning_en: Having a pleasant and good flavor.
example_en: This cake is very tasty.
examples_extra: This cake is very tasty.
Michel's food is very tasty.

meaning_en: Communication of thoughts without speaking or senses.
example_en: Some people believe in telepathy.
examples_extra: Some people claim telepathy exists.
Telepathy is hard to prove.

meaning_en: Of the highest quality; excellent.
example_en: The restaurant serves top-notch food.
examples_extra: This expensive hotel provides truly top-notch service.
She did a top-notch job on the project.

meaning_en: The sense by which you feel things.
example_en: The fabric has a soft touch.
examples_extra: Babies learn about the world through touch.
Her touch on the piano was light and gentle.

meaning_en: To put your hand or finger on something.
example_en: Please don't touch the wet paint.
examples_extra: Please do not touch the wet paint on the wall.
She gently touched his shoulder to wake him.

meaning_en: To look at something for a period of time.
example_en: I like to watch movies on weekends.
examples_extra: We watched the beautiful sunset together yesterday.
She watches the evening news daily at six.

meaning_en: A person who saw a crime or event.
example_en: The police asked the witness what happened.
examples_extra: The witness saw the accident.
Two witnesses spoke to the police.

meaning_en: Extremely quiet and silent.
example_en: The children were as quiet as a mouse during the exam.
examples_extra: The children were as quiet as a mouse.
She sat as quiet as a mouse.

meaning_en: The environment is too noisy to concentrate properly.
meaning_fa: از سر و صدا نمی‌توان فکر کرد
example_en: Turn down that music; I can't hear myself think!
examples_extra: It is so noisy you can't hear yourself think.
The party was so loud I can't hear myself think.
note_fa: اصطلاح: آن‌قدر شلوغ که نمی‌شود فکر کرد.

meaning_en: The room was extremely quiet.
example_en: During the exam, you could hear a pin drop.
examples_extra: You could hear a pin drop when she entered.
After the announcement, you could hear a pin drop.
note_fa: اصطلاح برای سکوت مطلق؛ همیشه با could.

meaning_en: To make a long, squeaking sound, like old wood.
example_en: The old floorboards creaked loudly as he walked across them.
examples_extra: The old door creaked loudly.
The floorboards creak when you walk.
note_fa: جیرجیر کردن چوب یا در قدیمی.

meaning_en: Strange and frightening in a mysterious way.
example_en: An eerie silence fell over the abandoned house.
examples_extra: An eerie silence filled the old, empty house.
The abandoned place felt strangely eerie at night.

meaning_en: Irritating or unpleasant, especially a sound.
example_en: His constant complaining has a grating effect on everyone.
examples_extra: His grating voice annoyed everyone.
The grating noise kept me awake.

meaning_en: To hit something repeatedly with force.
example_en: He hammered the nail into the wood firmly.
examples_extra: He hammered the nail in.
Heavy rain hammered on the roof.
note_fa: چکش زدن/کوبیدن؛ hammer out a deal یعنی «توافق کردن».

meaning_en: A sound that is very high in tone.
meaning_fa: زیر، با صدای بلند و نازک
example_en: The baby let out a high-pitched scream.
examples_extra: She has a high-pitched voice.
The loud alarm is high-pitched.

meaning_en: To make a loud, piercing sound, like an owl.
meaning_fa: بوق زدن، جیغ کشیدن، صدای جغد
example_en: The owl hooted softly in the night.
examples_extra: The owl hooted in the night.
Drivers hooted their horns impatiently in traffic.

meaning_en: Impossible to hear; too quiet.
example_en: Her whisper was almost inaudible over the crowd's noise.
examples_extra: Her voice was almost inaudible.
The recording was too faint and inaudible.

meaning_en: Without making any sound; very quietly.
example_en: The cat moved noiselessly across the polished floor.
examples_extra: She moved noiselessly upstairs once again tonight.
He crept noiselessly away at dawn today.

meaning_en: Very loud and sharp, often unpleasant.
example_en: A piercing scream echoed through the silent night.
examples_extra: A piercing scream woke us.
She has piercing blue eyes.

meaning_en: To hit something repeatedly with great force.
example_en: The waves pounded against the rocky shore.
examples_extra: Waves pounded the rocks all night.
She pounded on the door loudly.
note_fa: کوبیدن؛ ضربه زدن مکرر با شدت.

meaning_en: (of a sound) to be heard loudly and clearly
example_en: Laughter rang out through the entire hall.
examples_extra: Applause will ring out across the hall.
The church bells will ring out at midnight.

meaning_en: A movie without synchronized recorded sound.
example_en: Charlie Chaplin starred in many famous silent films.
examples_extra: They watched a silent film.
Chaplin starred in silent films.

meaning_en: A movie without synchronized recorded sound.
example_en: We watched an old silent movie with live piano music.
examples_extra: The festival showed silent movies.
She really loves silent movies.

meaning_en: To make a hissing sound when frying.
example_en: The bacon began to sizzle in the hot pan.
examples_extra: The bacon sizzles in the pan.
We heard the sausages sizzle.

meaning_en: To shut with great force and a loud noise.
example_en: He slammed the door in anger.
examples_extra: She slammed the door angrily.
Don't slam the brakes hard!

meaning_en: Making no sound; completely silent.
example_en: The soundless forest was eerily beautiful at dawn.
examples_extra: The room was completely soundless.
She moved with soundless steps.

meaning_en: Without making any sound.
example_en: The cat moved soundlessly through the tall grass.
examples_extra: She closed the door soundlessly.
He crept soundlessly up the stairs.

meaning_en: To make a short, high-pitched sound.
example_en: The old door hinges squeaked loudly when opened.
examples_extra: The old door squeaks loudly.
The mouse gave a loud squeak.

meaning_en: Make a short, sharp sound with a horn.
example_en: The driver gave a quick toot of the horn.
examples_extra: The driver tooted his horn.
He gave a toot on the whistle.

meaning_en: To make a long, loud, high-pitched cry.
example_en: The baby began to wail loudly after dropping its toy.
examples_extra: The baby wailed all night.
Sirens wailed in the distance.
